user.title: Add a Tacktab tablet
user.description: In Tacktab, open Settings (hold the top-left corner for 3 seconds), turn on Remote control API and set a password. Tacktab shows the tablet's address there.

discovery_confirm.title: Add {name}
discovery_confirm.description: Tacktab was found at {host}. Enter the API password from Tacktab's settings.

reauth_confirm.title: Tacktab password changed
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the new API password from Tacktab's settings.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach Tacktab. Check the address, and that Remote control API is on and Tacktab is open.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong passwords. Tacktab is refusing this Home Assistant for a while; wait a minute, then try again with the right password.

abort.not_supported: This Tacktab version is too old for discovery. Add it by address instead.
